topics.label: Opening Framing and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture theme of cancer evolution, reviews prior concepts, and outlines the session's key learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cellular-level genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer fitness advantages to drive clonal tumor evolution.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and the Cancer Stem Cell Model
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how normal tissue hierarchies and stem cell properties influence tumor initiation and hierarchical propagation across different cancer types.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Regulation of Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how microenvironmental cues, stroma, and chronic inflammation cooperate with intrinsic mutations to promote tumor initiation and sustain growth.

topics.label: Technologies for Profiling Tumor Plasticity and Spatial Architecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes single-cell sequencing and spatial omics technologies used to map tumor heterogeneity and cell-microenvironment interactions.

topics.label: Multifactorial Synthesis of Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic integrates mutations, transcriptional states, cell of origin, and microenvironmental conditions into a unified evolutionary model of cancer development.

topics.label: Closing Framing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture session and previews the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
